description: 3-email re-engagement sequence for cold leads. Aimed at rekindling interest with existing contacts who haven't engaged in 60+ days.

We Miss You, Dr. {{first_name}}! 👋

It's been a while since we last connected. I wanted to reach out and share what's been happening at MBMB — because a lot has changed!

Since we last spoke, MBMB has:

  • Added new specialty expertise in orthopedics and pain management

emails.preheader: Important updates that may affect your practice revenue

email_content.html_content:
Medical Billing Miami Beach

MBMB

Is Your Billing Partner Keeping Up with Florida's 2026 Changes? ⚠️

Dr. {{first_name}}, healthcare billing regulations are constantly evolving. Here are some critical updates affecting Florida practices this year:

📋 Key Florida Updates:

  • New modifier requirements for telehealth visits
  • Updated payer mix requirements for Florida Medicaid
  • HIPAA Phase 2 enforcement intensifying
  • CPT code changes for evaluation and management services

Is your current billing partner proactively adapting to these changes? If you're not sure, we offer a free compliance audit to assess where your practice stands.

We stay ahead of regulatory changes so you can focus on patient care. Our team attends payer updates, participates in billing associations, and continuously updates our processes.
